title: The Ethical Dilemma when (not) Setting up Cost-based Decision Rules in Semantic Segmentation
reasoning: The paper explores the ethical implications of decision-making in autonomous vehicle perception systems. It specifically evaluates how defining 'egoistic' or 'altruistic' cost matrices for semantic segmentation affects safety-relevant metrics like precision and recall, framing the technical choice as a moral dilemma related to robot ethics and the trolley problem.
